heading: Expression node kinds
text:
### Expression node kinds [IRET.9.1]

An expression is a tree of nodes, each of one kind:

| Kind | Node is |
|---|---|
| literal | an `Int`, `Float`, `String` or `Bool` constant, or `null` ([LNUL.2.1]) |
| var | a fact slot reference — (pattern position, slot index) |
| binop | binary arithmetic, comparison, logical or bitwise |
| unop | unary `not`, bitwise-not, or negate |
| call | a builtin invocation — op plus arguments ([IRET.13.1]) |
| interp | an interpolated string: literal text, values under their specs, time fields ([RLOW.6.4]) |
| now | reads the clock source |
| json-path | traversal of a `Json` value by path |
| if | a conditional |
| bind / bind-ref | a `let` binding and a reference to one |
| coalesce | `left ?? right`, evaluating `left` once ([LNUL.8.9]) |
| is-test | `x is <subject>`, a total tag test ([LNUL.4.9]) |
| entry-stamp | the entry stamp of the fact bound at a pattern position ([LTIM.2.8.6]) |

Two of these are narrower than their names suggest, and the narrowing
is deliberate:

**Var is positional**, naming a pattern position and a slot index rather
than a name. Name resolution happens at lowering, so evaluation never
performs a lookup.

**Bind exists because a `let` may be sync-impure.** A pure `let` folds
at lowering and leaves no node behind; the bind/bind-ref pair is what
remains when it cannot.
